title: Hangover-Cure Pungent Mediterranean Grape Tomatoes Pizza
description: A hearty, plant-based pizza to cure your hangover, loaded with pungent flavors and gooey cheese.

ingredients.name: Pizza Dough (Gluten-Free)
ingredients.notes: Use a store-bought gluten-free pizza dough or make your own using a mix of rice flour, almond flour, and water.

ingredients.name: Pizza Sauce
ingredients.notes: Make your own sauce using crushed tomatoes, olive oil, garlic, and oregano, or use a store-bought variety.

ingredients.name: Grape Tomatoes
ingredients.notes: Halve or quarter the tomatoes depending on their size.

ingredients.name: Roasted Garlic
ingredients.notes: Mince the garlic and mix with olive oil.

instructions: Roll out the pizza dough to a thickness of 1/4 inch (6 mm).
Transfer the dough to a piece of parchment paper or a lightly floured pizza peel, if you have one.
Spread the pizza sauce evenly over the dough, leaving a 1/2 inch (1 cm) border around the edges.
Arrange the grape tomatoes, artichoke hearts, roasted garlic, and goat cheese on top of the sauce.
Drizzle the olive oil over the toppings and sprinkle with salt, black pepper, and red pepper flakes, if using.
Slide the parchment paper or pizza peel onto the air fryer basket and cook for 10-12 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the cheese is melted and gooey.
Remove the pizza from the air fryer and let it cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
Garnish with fresh basil leaves, if desired.
